purpose: Finite diagnosis of delivery cost from one retained window and three task histories; no product acceptance verdict.

window.selection_semantics: Inclusive session-start cohort, not event-time usage clipped to twelve hours.

prior_audit.finding: The specified shared ledger contains only this record; no earlier audit or before/after baseline is available there.

interpretation: Input sums tokens processed over model calls, repeatedly including prior context. Cached input is part of input, not an additional quantity.

Uncached input is input minus cached input. It is not a count of unique new prompt text, quota debit or money; repeated context can be uncached too. Output, provider pricing and billing are not in the aggregate, so no spending or saving is calculated.

Attempt turn.completed usage is cumulative within a resumed native session. The attempt table subtracts the preceding completion for the same session, then sums session endpoints; it never sums cumulative endpoints as separate turns.

The read action has the largest classified worker share, but reading includes necessary discovery. The noDecisionShare label combines waits, tests and commits; those include useful verification and delivery, so neither classifier estimates avoidable waste.
Actions split a step weight equally across unique pending action names. Classification by command regex is approximate, not measured wall time or a causal allocation.
Nine one-turn tasks out of 49 observed task IDs do not establish first-attempt landing share. A parked continuation is a resumed worker turn, not automatically rework or a failed review.

coverage_and_attribution_limits.limit: readSession rejects an entire session whose first relevant timestamp precedes since, even if resumed during the window. Older-started managers/workers are omitted; their number and cost cannot be recovered from this aggregate.

After admission by first timestamp, readSession does not clip subsequent events at until. The snapshot was collected 21.395 seconds after until and may include a selected session tail through collection. It is not an exact event-time twelve-hour ledger.

Only configured session-home files recognized by the collector are represented. Missing homes, unrecognized providers/formats, outputs, executor CPU, queue time and external service costs are not a complete delivery-cost ledger.

Task assignment takes the first worktrees/g-N mention anywhere in a log. Role assignment uses the first eligible user message and two review prefixes. A mentioned worktree can therefore influence attribution independently of the actual owner.

The 66 other sessions and 205063715 input tokens are not a measured manager-only numerator. The two recognized landing reviews used 1636421 input tokens (0.2962% of all input despite the rounded 0% field); unrecognized or older-started reviews may be elsewhere or omitted. Manager/worker/review shares cannot be completed by inference.

byEngine is empty, and the snapshot retains only the ten largest of 49 task totals. It has no session/event identifiers or task-kind/landing join. Model comparisons and a full same-kind landed denominator with matching inputs are unavailable.

The collector sums last_token_usage for each matching token_count record. The aggregate lacks invocation identifiers to test for repeated count records. This is an instrumentation uncertainty, not a demonstrated duplicate-count defect.

Retained task logs are used for causes and their own session deltas. Post-window ledger state is used only with dated train/merge receipts; no current state or worker handoff substitutes for historical landing or product proof.
